plugin-tmdb.name: Movie Database (TMDB / Jellyfin)
plugin-tmdb.description: Movie and TV details, ratings, cast, and watch options.

apiKey.label: TMDB API key
apiKey.description: Required for movie, TV, and actor details. Get a key at themoviedb.org/settings/api.
apiKey.placeholder: Get a free key at themoviedb.org/settings/api

language.label: TMDB language
language.description: Follow the interface language or choose a content language. Missing descriptions fall back to English.

youtubeBaseUrl.label: YouTube / Invidious URL
youtubeBaseUrl.description: Optional trailer frontend URL. Leave blank for YouTube; thumbnails use degoog’s image proxy.

jellyfinUrl.label: Jellyfin URL (internal)
jellyfinUrl.description: Optional Jellyfin API address reachable from the degoog server.

jellyfinExternalUrl.label: Jellyfin URL (external)
jellyfinExternalUrl.description: Public address for links. Uses the internal URL when empty.

jellyfinApiKey.label: Jellyfin API key
jellyfinApiKey.description: Required with the Jellyfin URL to enable library integration.

seerrUrl.label: Seerr URL
seerrUrl.description: Optional Overseerr/Jellyseerr/Seerr address for availability and request status.

seerrApiKey.label: Seerr API key
seerrApiKey.description: Required with the Seerr URL for requests and fallback Rotten Tomatoes ratings.

omdbApiKey.label: OMDb API key
omdbApiKey.description: Optional IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings. Get a key at omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx.

plugin-tmdb.letterboxdTooltip: Letterboxd (community scores are on the site; there is no public rating API)
